recognize_zh: 腦部 MRI FLAIR 未見明顯異常，周邊血液出現少數大型異常淋巴球；骨髓切片看似造血細胞為主，但免疫染色（B 細胞標記）顯示大型陽性細胞沿著竇狀血管內呈線性排列，說明腫瘤細胞侷限在血管腔內，符合血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Brain MRI (FLAIR, axial) without evident parenchymal signal abnormality or mass
Peripheral blood: occasional large atypical lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio, fine to slightly open chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm
Bone marrow biopsy H&E: cellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis; large atypical cells inconspicuous on H&E
Inset schematic outlines the tortuous sinusoidal distribution
IHC (B-cell marker, likely CD20): large positive cells confined to marrow sinusoids in linear/branching intravascular pattern
describe_en: Axial FLAIR MRI of the brain shows no evident parenchymal abnormality. Peripheral blood smear contains occasional large atypical lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm. The bone marrow biopsy appears relatively unremarkable on H&E, but immunohistochemistry for a B-cell marker highlights large atypical cells distributed exclusively within sinusoidal lumens in a linear, branching pattern. In a patient with rapidly progressive neurological deterioration, findings are consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma; random skin and marrow biopsies are useful diagnostic sites when imaging is unrevealing.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with marrow involvement
ddx.vs: Forms interstitial or nodular extravascular aggregates rather than cells restricted to sinusoidal lumens.
Also intrasinusoidal, but consists of small lymphocytes with low proliferation rather than large atypical B cells.
Shows the same intravascular pattern but cells are CD20 negative, CD3/CD56 positive and EBER positive.
HLH shows hemophagocytic macrophages without CD20-positive large cells in vessels, though the two may coexist.

stain: MRI FLAIR; Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD20 (likely)
